description:
The Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has a requirement for upfit of law enforcement vehicles as detailed in the attached Draft Statement of Work. 

All capability statements shall be submitted in writing via e-mail, no later than Friday, April 24, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time (EST) to Contract Specialist, Amy Dallaire at Amy.Dallaire@ice.dhs.gov and the Contracting Officer, Yasmin Atkins at Yasmin.Atkins@ice.dhs.gov.  No capability statements will be accepted after the deadline.
